purpose: Selected authored narrative material for a later general language and retention experiment, prepared separately from the frozen binding comparison.
policy: Only these selected Gutenberg text editions enter this corpus. Founders use random weights and fixed byte IDs. Validation and test books never supply learning targets. Source texts retain their own terms; the project MIT license covers original code.
stage_note: Stages group short collections, sustained adventures and longer novels. They are content-organization labels, not human ages or validated mastery levels. An experiment must declare exposure and compare ordered with shuffled content before claiming an ordering benefit.
edition_note: Selected historical language material. Original notices remain in cached raw editions. The project code license does not relicense these sources. Fiction and historical social assumptions are not modern factual ground truth.

stages.name: Short narrative collections
stages.focus: Animal characters, everyday actions, dialogue and short event sequences.

stages.name: Sustained adventures
stages.focus: Recurring characters, changes of place and dialogue across chapters.

stages.name: Longer stories
stages.focus: Larger casts, motivations, descriptions and extended narrative context.
